label: Integrations
seo_description: Connect LMS, payments, and messaging with clear activation rules—know what is live, for whom, and why.
headline: Integrations your operators can trust.
subheadline: School teams connect external tools without losing audit context—activation, ownership, and rollback stay explicit.

segments.title: Governed connections
segments.body: See which integrations are enabled per tenant, who approved them, and what data flows apply.

segments.title: Standards-friendly APIs
segments.body: Patterns such as LTI, REST, and roster exchange—scoped to what your deployment exposes.

segments.title: Safer toggles
segments.body: Turn integrations on or off with traceability—not anonymous switches in a crowded admin menu.

faqs.question: Which standards do you support?
faqs.answer: Supported patterns depend on your contract and environment—see developer docs for the matrix that applies to your tenant.

faqs.question: Who can turn integrations on?
faqs.answer: Tenant and platform rules decide activation; auditable changes preserve accountability.
